title: I AM THE MUSIC VIDEO
passages: For years, my creativity had lived behind a camera or a pair of FPV goggles. I knew how to contribute through a skill. I knew how to make someone else's moment look and feel extraordinary.

Now I was becoming curious about being the subject. Watching my own movement. Choosing the song. Editing my own life into something I could feel and understand. I still loved making the video. I was discovering what it meant to be inside it.

reflections.prompt: What changes when you let yourself be seen?
Choose an ordinary moment from your day. If it were a scene in your own film, what would you want it to say?
